identity_assurance.decision: Synthetic local human and workload identities are permitted only for deterministic Developer Trial fixtures
identity_assurance.m1Evidence: Authenticated principal and complete delegation chain bind every run
identity_assurance.beforeTrialEvidence: Approved identity provider and assurance levels are tested

tenant_topology.decision: One test tenant may run locally, but tenant/workspace/project scope remains logically explicit and server-derived
tenant_topology.enforcement: Workspace resolution and every storage/transport adapter
tenant_topology.m1Evidence: Cross-scope request is denied before repository discovery
tenant_topology.beforeTrialEvidence: Integrated store, cache, queue, context, telemetry, and evidence isolation suite passes

repository_credentials.decision: Before M1, only a contract-test repository adapter is allowed; reusable or production credentials are prohibited
repository_credentials.enforcement: Secret resolution inside the worker boundary
repository_credentials.m1Evidence: Short-lived task-scoped credential reference cannot be disclosed or reused
repository_credentials.beforeTrialEvidence: Selected provider credential issuance, expiry, revocation, and cleanup pass

worker_isolation.decision: No worker isolation is currently implemented; M1 requires a separate process with bounded filesystem, network, time, resource, and credential scope
worker_isolation.enforcement: External worker launcher and operating-system boundary
worker_isolation.m1Evidence: Escape, egress, quota, cancellation, and cleanup contract tests pass
worker_isolation.beforeTrialEvidence: Host-specific isolation and recovery tests pass

context_classification.decision: Context defaults to Internal and inherits the highest included classification; Restricted fixture content is excluded from unauthorized destinations
context_classification.enforcement: Context assembly before discovery and content return
context_classification.m1Evidence: Manifest preserves source, classification, omission, and envelope binding
context_classification.beforeTrialEvidence: Deletion, staleness, provider-destination, and reproduction suites pass

retention.decision: F0 fixtures use named candidate retention classes; no production duration is invented
retention.enforcement: Evidence, telemetry, context, and fixture lifecycle owners
retention.m1Evidence: Every emitted record declares a retention class and avoids unrestricted payloads
retention.beforeTrialEvidence: Owner-approved expiry, deletion, legal-hold, and backup-reconciliation schedule passes

evidence_integrity.decision: F0 uses immutable subject digests and reference integrity; signing and key design remain unresolved
evidence_integrity.m1Evidence: Mutation of subject or reference is detected and evidence unavailability blocks publication
evidence_integrity.beforeTrialEvidence: Selected integrity, recovery, disclosure, and key-compromise procedures pass

telemetry_minimization.decision: Telemetry records safe categories and measurements only; source, prompts, credentials, personal data, and key identifiers are prohibited
telemetry_minimization.m1Evidence: Seeded sensitive markers are absent from logs, traces, metrics, errors, and routine evidence
telemetry_minimization.beforeTrialEvidence: Integrated leakage suite and access/retention controls pass

cancellation.decision: Cancellation stops new work, prevents publication, revokes resolvable task credentials, and records cleanup outcome
cancellation.enforcement: Delivery control and external worker launcher
cancellation.m1Evidence: Cancelled work cannot resolve credentials or publish and can enter manual recovery safely
cancellation.beforeTrialEvidence: Interruption and cleanup timing are measured on supported hosts

revocation.decision: Parent or principal revocation invalidates narrower authority and triggers re-evaluation or cancellation
revocation.enforcement: Identity, policy, secret, worker, and publication gates
revocation.m1Evidence: Revoked authority prevents later context, tool, secret, and publication actions
revocation.beforeTrialEvidence: Propagation bounds and offline semantics are accepted

source_control_destination.decision: F0 and deterministic M1 tests use a contract double; a live destination requires exact repository binding, approval, idempotency, and evidence readiness
source_control_destination.m1Evidence: Unauthorized destination, changed digest, expired approval, and ambiguous publication tests pass
source_control_destination.beforeTrialEvidence: A selected provider passes credential, reconciliation, audit, and deletion tests
